evals.name: level-judgment
evals.prompt: 判断规范等级: 用户请求 '修复登录页面一个 typo'
expectations: Should judge as Level 1 (Skip) for trivial fix
Should explain why Level 1 was chosen

evals.name: bilingual-support
evals.prompt: 双语输入处理: 'Add a dark mode feature / 添加深色模式功能' — 请生成英文 proposal
expectations: Should correctly parse mixed Chinese/English input
Should generate proposal content in English as requested
Should preserve the feature intent from both language inputs
Generated proposal header blockquote contains a line starting exactly with `> **Linked Issue**:` (canonical English spelling; `关联 Issue` alias, `Related Issue`, or omitting the line fails)

Since the prompt names no tracking issue, the Linked Issue value is exactly `none` inside an inline code span (a left-in placeholder such as `{<org>/<repo>#<n>}`, an empty value, `N/A`, or a markdown link fails)

evals.name: linked-issue-field-authoring-TARGETED
evals.prompt: 请用 spec-drafter 为一个小功能新建一份 Level 2 proposal: 「给 state-scanner 的 🎫 Open Issues 区块加一个按 label 过滤的可选参数」。这个功能没有关联的 issue (已核实)。只在回答里输出 proposal.md 全文, 不要写入仓库, 不要运行 git 或任何脚本。
expectations: proposal.md 头部 blockquote 含一行逐字以 `> **Linked Issue**:` 起首 (英文 canonical 拼写; 写成 `关联 Issue` / `Related Issue` / 省略该行 均不算)
该行的值是 inline code span 且逐字为 `none` (无关联已核实 ⇒ 哨兵; 留空 / `N/A` / `TBD` / 保留 `{<org>/<repo>#<n>}` 占位串 均不算)
该行不是 markdown 链接形 (行内无 `](http`), 且不留空
头部四行顺序 Level → Status → Created → Linked Issue 与 SOT 模板一致 (含 `> **Created**:` 行)
没有把字段译写成别的名字 (全文无 `Related Issue` / `Issue Link` / `关联 Issue` 作为头部字段名)
